title: King safety
line: Pawn shields, open lines, and when to leave the king in the center.

steps.text: The center is opening: pawns are coming off. A king left in the middle can be hit along the open lines.
Castle on the short side, away from the center.

also.e4e5: That is as strong here. This lesson castles first.

steps.after: Black grabs your pawn and leaves its king in the middle.

steps.text: Your king now hides behind a shield of pawns. Tap the three pawns in front of it.
steps.after: Keep them at home unless there is a reason. A pawn cannot move back to guard the squares it leaves.

steps.text: Put your rook on the open file, in line with Black's king.
steps.after: The knight is pinned to the king. Black guards it with a pawn.

steps.text: Take the pawn that guards the knight.
steps.after: The queen takes back. You gave a bishop for a pawn, but watch the pin.

steps.text: Bring out your knight to attack the queen. The pinned knight on e4 cannot take it.
steps.after: The queen runs. The knight on e4 is still pinned and attacked twice.
Your piece is back, and Black's king is still in the middle.

summary: Castle before the center opens and keep the pawns in front of your king. A king left in the middle gets hit.
